te: Discussed an approach to proposing a Ministry of Water Resources
se: The meeting discussed water resource management to prevent and solve floods and droughts sustainably, and agreed to raise questions, propose a motion in the Senate and hold a seminar to hear views from all sectors, leading to a proposal to set up a Ministry of Water Resources and to make it a national agenda. Details will be discussed later
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Water resource management to prevent and solve floods and droughts sustainably
Appointment of persons to the working group studying a review of regulations, laws and management structures for economic and social security and disasters (additional)

te: Follow-up on overlapping land problems in Nakhon Nayok, Kaeng Hang Maeo District and Pong Nam Ron District, Chanthaburi Province
se: The meeting wrote to Nakhon Nayok Province to follow up on progress in the case of residents' land overlapping public land (grazing land), and to Chanthaburi Province in the case of the Khun Song national forest reserve boundary overlapping communities, temples and schools in Kaeng Hang Maeo District. On overlapping land reform areas in Pong Nam Ron District, the meeting agreed that the province, the Agricultural Land Reform Office and the municipality should follow up together to solve the problem
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Petition disputing rights to residents' land overlapping public land (grazing land), and asking for title documents to be issued, Nakhon Nayok Province

Petition that the Khun Song national forest reserve boundary (Ministerial Regulation No. 219, B.E. 2510 (1967)) overlaps communities, temples, schools and farmland, Kaeng Hang Maeo District, Chanthaburi Province
Overlapping land reform area in Pong Nam Ron Subdistrict Municipality, Pong Nam Ron District, Chanthaburi Province, under the Royal Decree designating land reform areas B.E. 2536 (1993)
Changes and appointments of members of the Development Subcommittee

te: Petitions about farmland and electricity from people in Rayong and Chon Buri, and study visits on water and town planning scheduled
se: The meeting agreed to act on 3 petitions: about people without title documents for their farmland and without electricity in Samnak Thon Subdistrict, Ban Chang District, Rayong Province, and about land and electricity problems in Samae San Subdistrict, Sattahip District, Chon Buri Province. It approved study visits on sustainable water management in Rayong, and on town planning and the Damrongtham Centre in Chon Buri
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Petition that people in Samnak Thon Subdistrict, Ban Chang District, Rayong Province, have no title documents for their farmland and no electricity
Petition asking for help to solve the public's water supply and electricity problems, Samnak Thon Subdistrict Municipality, Rayong Province
Petition asking for help to solve land and electricity problems, Samae San Subdistrict, Sattahip District, Chon Buri Province
Study visit on sustainable water management, Rayong Province
Study visit on town planning and the work of the Damrongtham Centre, Chon Buri Province, 20 August 2025

te: Set up a working group to study a review of water laws, and the problem of children and young people addicted to phones and social media
se: The meeting approved setting up a working group to study a review of laws related to water management (regulatory guillotine) and the problem of phone and social media addiction among children and young people, and considered 3 petitions: overlapping land reform land in Pong Nam Ron District, Chanthaburi Province, road repairs in Thawi Watthana District, Bangkok, and a request to review the performance of duties of a state agency
it: Set up a working group to study a review of laws related to water management (regulatory guillotine), and the problem of phone and social media addiction among children and young people
Petition asking to solve the problem of overlapping land reform areas, Pong Nam Ron Subdistrict Municipality, Pong Nam Ron District, Chanthaburi Province
Petition asking for help to repair a road in a village lane, Thawi Watthana District, Bangkok
Petition from a private party asking for a review of the performance of duties of a state agency, as alleged by the petitioner
Appointment of honorary advisers (1) and advisers to the Subcommittee on Central and Provincial Administration (1)

te: Gave its views on the draft Parliament regulation on committee summons letters, and approved a study visit to the groundwater bank on Ko Samet
se: The meeting approved the draft Parliament regulation on the criteria and procedure for delivering committee summons letters, and made observations on the draft regulation on travel expenses for persons giving facts. It noted the work of the subcommittees, such as the study visits to Chachoengsao and Pattaya City and the groundwater bank projects in Chaiyaphum and on Ko Samet, and approved a study visit to Ko Samet, Rayong Province
it: The Central Subcommittee is preparing a study report on an approach to policy plans as a framework for area-based national development

Development Subcommittee: results of the study visit to Chachoengsao Provincial Hall (3 July 2025) / the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration and the Department of Lands invited to give information on a petition about allocated land and land tax (23 July) / e-Service study visit at Pattaya City Hall (31 July 2025)
Sustainable groundwater bank projects in Chaiyaphum Province and on Ko Samet, Rayong Province
Draft Parliament regulation on the criteria and procedure for delivering committee summons letters B.E. ....
Draft regulation on travel expenses for persons giving statements of fact or views to committees B.E. ....
Appointment of honorary advisers (additional)

te: The Office of the National Water Resources clarified the 20-year water master plan; follow-up on land allocation after forest reserve land was returned in Chumphon
se: The meeting heard Chumphon Province, the Chumphon Provincial Police and the Royal Forest Department clarify an approach to allocating land use after the return of the Rap Ro and Salui national forest reserves in Tha Sae District, and heard the Office of the National Water Resources clarify the 20-year water resource management master plan (B.E. 2561–2580). The 2 draft Parliament regulations were moved to the next meeting
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Draft Parliament regulation on the delivery of committee summons letters, and draft Parliament regulation on travel expenses for persons giving statements of fact to committees
Petition about the use of allocated land, and a request for relief from land and building tax

Approach to allocating land use after the return of the Rap Ro and Salui national forest reserves, Hong Charoen Subdistrict, Tha Sae District, Chumphon Province (Chumphon Province, the Chumphon Provincial Police and the Royal Forest Department invited)
The 20-year water resource management master plan (B.E. 2561–2580) and integration of agencies (clarified by the Office of the National Water Resources)
The Development Subcommittee visits e-Service and the environment of Khlong Lat Phrao
Appointment of 1 honorary advisers

te: Considered the report on the visit to the Netherlands, and prepared to study the 20-year water master plan and the problem of housing in forest reserves
se: The meeting considered the draft summary report on the bilateral meeting in the Netherlands and an approach to a seminar on integrating national disaster management, and agreed to invite the agencies concerned to give information on water resource management under the master plan of the 20-year National Strategy and on the problem of farming or living in national forest reserves
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Draft summary report on the trip for the bilateral meeting in the Kingdom of the Netherlands, 31 May–6 June 2025
Approach to a seminar on national disaster management and integrating agencies
Water resource management under the master plan of the 20-year National Strategy, to prevent floods
Use of or living on land in national forest reserves

te: A petition from fishers in Khlung District, Chanthaburi Province, referred to the Committee on Agriculture and Cooperatives
se: The meeting noted the work of the subcommittees, and considered a petition from fishers in Khlung District, Chanthaburi Province, asking for fairness in the enforcement of the law on certain fishing gear. It referred the matter to the Committee on Agriculture and Cooperatives, which has direct responsibility, and appointed additional advisers
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Petition from fishers in Khlung District, Chanthaburi Province, asking for fairness in the enforcement of the law on stow-net fishing and push-net boats
Appointment of honorary advisers and advisers to the Subcommittee on Central and Provincial Administration

te: Proposed that the committee chair take part in examining the background of persons nominated as judges of the Constitutional Court
se: The meeting approved guidelines for study visits, approved a subcommittee visit to electronic public services in Chachoengsao Province, and approved nominating Pol.Lt.Gen. Yootana Thaipakdi, chair of the committee, as a member of the standing committee to examine the background, conduct and ethical behaviour of persons nominated as judges of the Constitutional Court
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Guidelines for study visits by the committee and subcommittees
The Development Subcommittee visits electronic public services (e-Service) and hears views on the draft Act on Facilitation of Licensing Consideration, Chachoengsao Province, 4 July 2025
Nominated a representative as a member of the standing committee to examine the background, conduct and ethical behaviour of persons nominated as judges of the Constitutional Court

te: Agencies clarified approaches to waterlogging and wastewater at Khlong Bang Nam Chuet, Samut Sakhon Province
se: The meeting heard the agencies concerned clarify how to prevent and solve waterlogging in the rainy season and wastewater in the dry season caused by obstructions to the waterway under the bridge over Khlong Bang Nam Chuet, Bang Nam Chuet Subdistrict, Mueang Samut Sakhon District, and noted the approach to the summary report on the visit to the Netherlands
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted

Waterlogging in the rainy season and wastewater in the dry season from obstructions to the waterway under the bridge over Khlong Bang Nam Chuet, Bang Nam Chuet Subdistrict, Mueang Samut Sakhon District
Approach to the summary report on the bilateral meeting in the Kingdom of the Netherlands

te: Agencies invited to discuss obstructions to the waterway under the Khlong Bang Nam Chuet bridge, Rama 2 Road, affecting farmers
se: The meeting approved the subcommittee inviting agencies to give information on the draft Local Administration Act and the draft Expropriation Act, and approved a study visit to tsunami risk areas. On agricultural problems caused by obstructions to the waterway under the bridge over Khlong Bang Nam Chuet, Rama 2 Road, the meeting agreed to invite the Department of Highways, the Royal Irrigation Department and the farmers' councils concerned to discuss
it: The subcommittee invited the Ministry of Social Development and Human Security, the Department of Provincial Administration, the Office of the Council of State, the Royal Thai Police and the Association of Kamnan and Village Headmen to give information on the draft Local Administration Act, 13 June 2025, and made a study visit on the comprehensive plan and the Damrongtham Centre in Chon Buri Province, 12 June 2025

The subcommittee invited the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration, the Department of Rural Roads, mass transit rail agencies, the Office of the Council of State and the Ministry of Finance to give information on the draft Expropriation Act, 11 June 2025
Study visit to tsunami risk areas, Phang Nga, Phuket and Krabi Provinces, 10–13 July 2025
Agricultural problems caused by obstructions to the waterway under the bridge over Khlong Bang Nam Chuet, Rama 2 Road
Preparations for the trip to the bilateral meeting in the Kingdom of the Netherlands
Appointment of honorary advisers to the committee (additional)

te: The Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation and the Royal Forest Department clarified flood relief payments and forest reserves in Chumphon
se: The meeting approved study visits by the Subcommittee on Central and Provincial Administration to Nakhon Pathom, Pathum Thani, Chachoengsao and Chon Buri Provinces. It then heard the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation clarify progress on relief payments to flood victims, and the Royal Forest Department clarify the matter of farmers without farmland and permits to use the Rap Ro–Salui national forest reserve, Chumphon Province
it: The Subcommittee on Central and Provincial Administration's study visits to Nakhon Pathom (22 May), Pathum Thani (4 June), Chachoengsao and Chon Buri (12–13 June 2025)
Flood prevention and solutions, and progress on relief payments to flood victims (clarified by the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation)
Farmers without farmland and permits to use the Rap Ro–Salui national forest reserve, Chumphon Province (clarified by the Royal Forest Department)

te: Study visit to Bangkok on floods and Traffy Fondue scheduled, and agencies invited to clarify relief payments and forest reserves in Chumphon
se: The meeting approved the programme of a study visit to Bangkok City Hall 2 on 21 May 2025 on town planning for flood prevention, drainage and water storage, relief for those affected, and receiving grievances through the Traffy Fondue platform. It also agreed to invite the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation and the Royal Forest Department to give information on relief payments to flood victims and on farmland problems in national forest reserves in Chumphon Province
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted

Study visit to Bangkok at Bangkok City Hall 2 (Din Daeng), 21 May 2025: town planning for flood prevention, drainage and water storage, integration, relief for those affected, and the Traffy Fondue platform
Progress on relief payments to flood victims
The problem of farmers without farmland, and objections to permits to use the Rap Ro–Salui national forest reserve, Chumphon Province

te: Studied the draft Act on Facilitation of Licensing Consideration, and prepared a disaster study visit in Bangkok
se: The meeting considered and studied the draft Act on Facilitation of Licensing Consideration and Public Services B.E. ...., prepared for the bilateral meeting in the Netherlands, and considered a study visit on Bangkok's disaster management. It also appointed a secretary and additional members of the disaster working group
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Draft Act on Facilitation of Licensing Consideration and Public Services B.E. ....
Travel for the bilateral meeting and visit to the Kingdom of the Netherlands, 31 May–6 June 2025
Study visit on overall disaster management in Bangkok
Appointment of a secretary of the committee and persons in the working group on crises and disasters (additional)

te: Assigned by the Senate to study disaster management after the earthquake of 28 March 2025
se: The Senate assigned the committee to study national disaster management after the earthquake in Myanmar on 28 March 2025, which affected Thailand. The meeting therefore set up a working group and invited the agencies concerned to give information. It also referred a petition on transport to the Committee on Transport
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Study of national disaster management after the earthquake in Myanmar on 28 March 2025 that affected Thailand (assigned by the Senate)
Petition about a state agency's termination of a contract and the appointment of an executive of a transport state enterprise, as the petitioner asks for a review
1 secretaries of the committee resigned

te: Studied the draft Expropriation Act and the draft Local Administration Act, with follow-up on earthquake damage
se: The meeting asked a subcommittee to study 2 draft Acts that the House of Representatives will consider accepting in principle: the draft Act on Expropriation and Acquisition of Immovable Property and the draft Local Administration Act. It also approved an exchange of views on earthquake damage, and on the comprehensive plan and the Damrongtham Centre, in Nonthaburi Province
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Draft Act on Expropriation and Acquisition of Immovable Property (No. ..) B.E. .... under Rule 119
Draft Local Administration Act (No. ..) B.E. .... under Rule 119
Study visit and exchange of views with state agencies and the private sector on earthquake damage, 15–18 April 2025
Study visit on the preparation of the Nonthaburi Comprehensive Plan and the work of the Damrongtham Centre, Nonthaburi Province, 23 April 2025
Appointment of honorary advisers and academics of the committee (additional)
